OUR STORY
One Italian story, over 90 years of machine-tool expertise.
PAMA is an Italian company that has been present in the machine tool market for over 90 years, known for building large and medium-large units, well appreciated in all sectors where maximum rigidity and high precision are required.

SUPPORT
PAMA is proud of its many years of experience in the field of machine tools and provides its customers with a wide range of services and contracts to ensure the sustained highest level of performance of its products.
From dedicated helpline and remote diagnosis to preventative maintenance and machine geometry optimisation, PAMA keeps machine tools productive over time.
